items.title: Should a widow leave her late partner’s home to her stepkids — or cut off contact with them?
items.content: “It would be a less drastic step than selling the home now and splitting the proceeds.”

items.title: Anthropic reportedly retracts IPO terms sent to banks by mistake, exposing jitters over AI investments
items.content: Anthropic reportedly late Monday sent a copy of a securities filing to bankers for an IPO raising up to $69.3 billion before saying that was in error.

items.title: ‘I’m sick of flying’: I paid for priority boarding, but the overhead bins were full. Was I duped?
items.content: “Maybe next time I’ll try the other approach: I’ll board whenever I feel like it and drop my suitcase in the first open slot I see.”

items.title: ‘The thought of living to 100 terrifies me’: Is Social Security a giant Ponzi scheme?
items.content: There’s already a demographic ‘run’ on Social Security.

items.title: N.Y. Knicks star Josh Hart relists Florida home for $5.7 million
items.content: New York Knicks star Josh Hart has relisted his sprawling Florida mansion for $5.69 million—just one year after removing the home from the selling block.

items.title: Actor Justin Baldoni quietly sold his L.A. home for $2.1 million after moving to Nashville
items.content: Actor Justin Baldoni discreetly offloaded his former Los Angeles home months after relocating to Nashville, Tenn., for a “fresh start.”

items.title: Fed’s Waller puts half-point rate hike into the mix for December
items.content: Federal Reserve Gov. Chris Waller on Tuesday put the possibility of a half-point rate hike into the mix, depending how hot the consumer price data for October comes in.

items.title: ‘We had the worst fight’: I want my husband to retire at 65, but I don’t want to lose his $280,000 salary. Is that unreasonable?
items.content: “We have $2.6 million, most of it in his 401(k) and IRAs, plus $450,000 in a brokerage account.”

items.title: The short seller who saw signs of Nvidia’s China scandal months ago claims Megaspeed isn’t the only company helping China access chips
items.content: ‘We were confident in the research initially, and we’re still confident in it now,’ says Christian Lamarco, founder of Culper Research

items.title: This retired professor has reinvented himself — as a Taylor Swift scholar
items.content: His niece convinced him to spend his retirement analyzing Taylor Swift lyrics. Now he’s a successful podcaster at 72.
